item.title: PM Modi pays tribute to Assam Movement Martyrs, attends events in Guwahati
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Swahid Smarak Kshetra at Paschim Boragaon in Guwahati today, where he paid homage to the martyrs of the Assam Movement. item.title: Saudi Arabia expands access to its only alcohol store in Riyadh for non-Muslim residents
item.description: Saudi Arabia has quietly expanded access to its only store that sells alcohol, allowing wealthy foreign residents to buy booze in the latest step in the once ultraconservative kingdom's experiment in liberalisation. There's been no official announcement of the decision, but word has gotten out, and long lines of cars and people can now be seen at the discreet, unmarked store in the Diplomatic Quarter of the Saudi capital, Riyadh. item.title: Google, Apple warn US staff with H-1B visas against International Travel: Report
item.description: Alphabet's Google and Apple have advised some employees on U.S. work visas to avoid international travel due to delays of up to 12 months for visa stamping appointments at embassies, Business Insider reported on Friday, citing internal memos. item.title: Yatin Oza elected president of Gujarat High Court Advocates' Association for 19th time
item.description: Senior Advocate Yatin Oza was as elected president of the Gujarat High Court Advocates' Association (GHCAA), marking another term in his long association with the body. He has been elected as GHCAA president 19 times. He became the youngest president of GHCAA at the age of 35 in 1994. He has been elected as vice president six times and once as secretary of association. item.title: BCCI Announces 15-member squad for T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has announced India’s squad for the upcoming five-match T20 series against New Zealand and the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026. item.description: Avatar: Fire and Ash collected Rs. 25.50 crore (Rs. 21 crore nett) / USD 2.85 million approx on its second day at the Indian box office. item.title: Where Has Gujarat’s Winter Gone? December 2025 Turns Unusually Warm as Cold Days Shrink Across the State.
item.description: Shrinking Winters Raise Alarm for Crops and Climate in Gujarat.
